heading: multiview MO — `shapeDepth` ranks a solid swept along v or u
text: Defect of `shapeDepthIn`, repaired (`S/🔨️modules/🧮️evaluation/🟦️.ts`): an extruded solid is ranked as `solid3` places it, its profile in the plane of its sweep (`w`: (u, v); `v`: (u, w); `u`: (v, w)) at the middle of its span, tapered to `zTip`; `sweep: "w"` without `zTip` is unchanged. Measured with your `🧰️matrix/MO/depth.ts used-classical-guitar 50 stored plan` after the repair: `lid-panel` 0.1420 (was 0.3528), `pocket` 0.1630 (0.2680), `back-panel` 0.0140 (0.2048), `strap-l` 0.0040 (−0.0500), the numbers the flat sheets had; the pocket ranks above the lid. Test first: vector `depth` of `🧫️fixtures/🧊️solid-sweep` and the three cases "ranks a solid swept along u|w|v …" (vector and gl-matrix); the removed line gives front 0.30 where the vector says 0.45 (u) and 0.01 (v) (`🧰️matrix/MX/depth-old.ts`). Suites: `🧊️solid-sweep` 21 of 21, `🧊️depth-order` 5 of 5, `🧊️chain-state` 18 of 20 (the two red cases are the ones the previous owner recorded, on `person-with-umbrella` and `person-on-crutches`; neither reads a swept solid in the front or plan). No matrix cell reads the paint order; sheets of poses in which two swept shapes of different bones overlap in the front or plan may paint in another order now, which is the repair.

heading: multiview ML-1 — `🧊️model-bounds`: 3 of the 4 heater cases fail
text: Measured again with your `🧰️matrix/ML-1/heater.ts` on the catalog document: 1:50 clear, bar, dial, 8 and 8 louvre bands; 1:100 clear, bar, dial, 4 (body) and 6 (thermal); 1:200 not clear, bar, dial, 1 and 1; 1:500 not clear, bar, dial in the thermal list only, 1 and 1. Verdict: not the asset, the case. `volumes-feature` allows no solid dimension below the smallest feature of the band (7.5, 15, 30, 75 mm) and the heater's `volumes.<scale>.decisions` state exactly these simplifications (four 15 mm slats for the eight, a solid lug because the opening would be 8 mm, the dial left out of the 1:500 body); eight 1.5 mm slats and a 26 mm opening cannot be asked of the 1:200 and 1:500 bodies. The case now states per band what the band resolves (decision D52 in `K/🗂️work-board.md`, table `HEATER_RESOLVES` in `🧪️tests/🧊️model-bounds/🟦️.ts`, scenario outline in its feature); the carry bar is asked at every scale as before. `🧊️model-bounds` with the filter `heater`: 4 of 4 (1 of 4 before); the bench cases beside it 4 of 4. No asset change. D52 is on the list for the dev: if the 1:50 detail is wanted in every band, the bodies of 1:100 to 1:500 need it as declared thin solids and `volumes-feature` an exemption.

heading: multiview MH-6 — tracer plates of the silhouette rounds
text: Read as a note; no rule or engine function was changed for it and none was measured again here. What the shared code now gives these parts: the union no longer throws on a traced outline copied into another view (see the answer under "multiview MH-6 — `evaluate`: the union of a prism swept along w"), and `shapeDepth` ranks prisms swept along v and u by their true depth. What it does not give: a drawing solid whose cross-section varies along the bone; the two the schema has (prism, body of revolution) are what your fits tried. The cure you name, the drawing remade from the volume solids of the band in one pass with the silhouette guard, is asset work for the six people; the engine alternative (a drawing solid lofted between sections, as the volumes have it) is a schema decision and is put to the dev in `multiview-MX.md`, with these six assets, the seven places of MH-4 and the three walkers of MH-2 as its cases. Until one of the two is done the findings stay open with the numbers of `multiview-MH-6.md` section 3.

heading: multiview MH-4 — `🧊️catalog-silhouette` and the multiview gate ask for opposite things
text: Not measured again here; no threshold of either gate was changed. Case by case: (1) `person-with-white-cane` 1:500 front `thigh-l`: a largest distance that grows from 80 to 167 mm while the IoU rises would fit the enclosed-pocket rule of the guard (a gap that closes or opens between the legs counts as outline or not; requests "silhouette SC — a small hole counts as outline or not …" and "silhouette SV-2"); that is a guess from your numbers, not a measurement, and it is for the owner of `🧊️catalog-silhouette` to confirm. The corrected thigh is the right drawing by your own sheets. (2) Hands as solids in the plan, (3) the plan of a trunk that leans far, (4) `person-stretching` at the IoU limit: the two drawing solids of the schema (prism along one bone axis, body of revolution) are not these bodies; both gates are right and the drawing cannot satisfy them with those two solids. The engine answer is the one you name, a drawing solid with a free cross-section along the bone; it is a schema decision and is put to the dev in `multiview-MX.md` together with MH-6's plates and MH-2's walkers. What changed in the shared code that touches these assets: `unionPolygons` no longer throws on such prisms, so `unlevel` is not needed, and `lateralScale` of a revolved drawing solid is still not read by `solid3` (request "three-views part 1 — `lateralScale` …", open; `person-with-white-cane` authors it), which is part of the same decision.

heading: multiview MH-2 — three walkers keep hard findings
text: Read as a note; nothing measured again here and no rule changed. Same verdict as under "multiview MH-6 — tracer plates" and "multiview MH-4 — `🧊️catalog-silhouette` and the multiview gate": hands, shoes at 1:50 and the nurse's sleeves are bodies neither a prism nor a circular body of revolution reproduces inside the guard; `solid3` does not read `lateralScale`, so an elliptic body of revolution is not available either (open request of three-views part 1). The plan remade from the volume solids of the band is asset work; the engine alternative (an elliptic or lofted drawing solid) is put to the dev in `multiview-MX.md` with the three walkers as cases.
